credits.title: Summer High
credits.overview: In 1987, two police officers with polar-opposite personalities must team up for the biggest case of their lives when thousands of cans filled with marijuana wash up on Brazilian beaches, threatening to plunge the country into total chaos.

credits.title: Caramelo
credits.overview: After a life-changing diagnosis, a promising chef finds hope and humor with the help of a fur-midable dog friend.

credits.title: Feminine Speeches 25'
credits.overview: Humor and critique blend seamlessly in this year's Female Lines. With stand-up comedy, sketches, and special guest appearances, the show dives into important themes of the female experiences.

credits.title: Undercover Party Crasher
credits.overview: In order to get evidence for her case and dismantle a criminal organization, an uptight undercover cop crashes a high school graduation trip to a party-heavy beach in Brazil.
